title: Terminal Deck Layout
description: Explains all-mounted-one-shown approach and split pane handling.
body: Every session's emulator is mounted once and kept mounted, with exactly one visible. One XTermView per session, all mounted at once, hidden with display: none rather than unmounted. display: none (not visibility) is deliberate — it makes a hidden container measure 0×0, which is the signal XTermView's ResizeObserver relies on.
